breakdown.description: The setup describes a vertical bubble column with gas injected to rise along the Y-axis, but gravity is applied horizontally, which would push the bubbles sideways instead of upwards.
breakdown.reason: The user's original request incorrectly applied gravity horizontally in a vertical bubble column. The generated specification corrected this by setting the gravity vector to `g (0 -9.81 0);`, which correctly applies gravity in the negative Y-direction, opposing the upward flow of the bubbles along the Y-axis.
